card.name: Religious text just before God is named
card.fires_on: Positions in religious or theological writing where the next word is likely to be God or a deity name. Includes scripture citation numbers, the word God itself, and deity names like Brahma.

modes.label: Scripture citations
modes.description: Verse numbers or colons inside a Bible reference that follows a mention of God.

modes.label: God and deity names
modes.description: The word God, a divine title, or the start of a deity name in theological discussion.

card.plain: It fires in religious writing where God has just been mentioned, and it pushes the model away from saying God again.
